The bug violating the requirements in [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_c_fix/requirement.feature) has been fixed.

### Root Cause
In [`CoreOperationCompare.equal`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_c_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/jxpath/ri/compiler/CoreOperationCompare.java#L45-L65), operands of type `InitialContext` were being collapsed into single node pointers via `((EvalContext) l).getSingleNodePointer()`. This prevented multi-valued variables represented by `InitialContext` from being iterated as collections when performing equality comparisons against single values.

### Fix
Updated [`CoreOperationCompare.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_c_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/jxpath/ri/compiler/CoreOperationCompare.java#L57-L69) so that when an operand is an `InitialContext`, its iteration position is reset via `reset()` rather than collapsed into a single pointer. This allows `CoreOperationCompare` to iterate across all elements of the multi-valued variable and compare each element to the target value according to XPath specifications.

The patch has been saved to [negative_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_c_fix/negative_fix.patch).
